title: VirtualKeyRequest
description: Issue a gateway virtual key to an agent instance (FR-702, E6.1). Only the instance's owner or sponsor may. The secret is shown once in the response and never stored.

aliases.description: Model aliases the key may call; each must be one the instance's template allows.

monthlyBudget.description: Calls are refused once this calendar month's recorded spend reaches it. Calls in flight can overshoot; the overshoot is reported, not hidden.
